insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: INR 2 Lacs, 3 Lacs, 4 Lacs, 5 Lacs, 7 Lacs, 10 Lacs, 15 Lacs, 20 Lacs, 25 Lacs, 50 Lacs, 75 Lacs, 1 Crore, 2 Crores, 3 Crores, 4 Crores, 5 Crores, 6 Crores (overall Sum Insured may include Super Reload, Super Credit, Cancer Booster etc. as applicable)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote:
Room Rent
Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One VYTL)
great.explanation: Room rent is payable at actuals up to the Sum Insured, with no daily room cap mentioned. This reduces the risk of room-rent linked deductions and lets you choose a suitable room.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote:
C.10 Super Reload
... provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“Super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year... 
From 2nd claim of Policy Life - Unlimited times
great.reference: Section C.10 Super Reload; Annexure III - Product Benefit Table
great.explanation: After the Base Sum Insured is used up, an additional amount equal to the Base Sum Insured is reloaded unlimited times during the policy year from the 2nd claim onwards. This helps you handle multiple hospitalizations without running out of cover.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One VYTL); Section C.4 Claim Protect
great.explanation: Items normally treated as non-payable are covered as per all 4 lists in Annexure I. This can significantly reduce out-of-pocket spend on consumables during hospitalization.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Medical expenses related to the same hospitalization are covered for up to 90 days before admission. This helps pay for consultations, tests, and medicines leading up to hospitalization.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote:
C.11 Super Credit
... will be applied / increased by a fixed percentage of the Base Sum Insured of immediately preceding Policy Year irrespective of any claims in previous Policy Year...
great.explanation: Sum Insured is increased by a fixed percentage of the previous year’s Base Sum Insured irrespective of claims in the previous policy year. This creates extra insurer-funded cover over time even if you claim.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Medical expenses related to the same hospitalization are covered for up to 180 days after discharge. This supports follow-up care and medicines during recovery.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Waiting Period - Inbuilt Cover)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 3 years of continuous coverage. This is within the common 2–4 year range in retail health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Specified diseases/procedures are not covered until 24 months of continuous coverage are completed. This is a standard market waiting period for listed conditions.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote:
D.1.3 30-day Waiting Period (Code-Excl03)
Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered for the first 30 days from policy start, except for accidents. This is the usual initial waiting period in most plans.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote:
C.5 Domiciliary Hospitalization
The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
good.explanation: Medical expenses for domiciliary hospitalization are covered during the policy period, subject to the policy conditions. This can help when treatment must be taken at home instead of a hospital.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote:
D.2.6 Specific treatment Exclusion
Treatment involving Rotational Field Quantum Magnetic Resonance (RFQMR), External Counter Pulsation (ECP), Enhanced External Counter Pulsation (EECP), Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy, KTP Laser Surgeries, Cyber Knife Treatment, Femto Laser Surgeries, Bioabsorbable Stents, Bioabsorbable Valves, Bioabsorbable Implants. Use of Radio Frequency (RF) probe for ablation.
bad.explanation: Several listed modern/advanced treatments (including Cyber Knife, Femto Laser surgeries, and bioabsorbable implants) are explicitly excluded. This can lead to full claim rejection if your treatment falls under these excluded procedures.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote:
C.15.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
... bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim... (only if treatment is taken in a Hospital other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”)
bad.reference: Section C.15.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
bad.explanation: A 10% co-payment applies on each and every claim if treatment is taken in a hospital outside the Preferred Provider Network. This directly increases your out-of-pocket cost whenever you use a non-PPN hospital.

unclear.name: Chronic Care OPD
unclear.quote:
C.13 Chronic Management Program (OPD)
... entitled to avail access to a fixed number of (i) Medical Practitioner’s consultations and (ii) diagnostic tests... as specified in the Policy Schedule. For details... refer Annexure IV
unclear.reference: Section C.13 Chronic Management Program (OPD); Annexure IV
unclear.explanation: OPD support under the chronic management program is limited to a fixed number of consultations and diagnostic tests as per the Policy Schedule/Annexure IV. The exact usable limits are not visible here, so you should check the schedule to know how much OPD support you actually get.

unclear.name: Home Health Care
unclear.quote:
C.6 Home Health Care
... The treatment is pre-authorized by the Company...
This Benefit requires pre-authorisation and is not available on reimbursement basis.
unclear.explanation: Home health care is only available with pre-authorization and is not payable on a reimbursement basis. If you start home care without insurer approval, the claim may not be payable.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: We reserve the right to modify, add or restrict any Network Provider for Cashless Facilities at Our sole discretion.
unclear.reference: Section E.2.7.1 (a) For Availing Cashless Facility
unclear.explanation: The insurer can modify, add, or restrict network providers for cashless facilities at its discretion. You should re-check hospital network status before admission to avoid ending up on reimbursement.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
